# Harshan Karthikeyan

> I build AI systems for businesses. I write here about what I am building, how I think about it, and where it goes next.

I help businesses adopt AI. More than 30 businesses in the last 2 years, drawing on a background as a systems and reliability engineer and an Australian Army veteran.

Harshan Karthikeyan runs Flowlamina (https://flowlamina.com), an AI automation consultancy based in Melbourne, Australia.

## Posts

- [17 Oct 26 - Reflection about my business](https://harshankarthikeyan.com/posts/business-reflections/): I pose myself some questions, such as how to stay relevant in the age of AI, how to stay balanced in the age of AI, and what systems I need so the business runs more autonomously.
- [Where I am at and where I'm going to go in the next 3 months](https://harshankarthikeyan.com/posts/key-ideas-from-a-business-mentor/): Reflections after a five-hour talk on thinking clearly. Six parts, thirty-three ideas, and the three I am holding myself to over the next three months.
